name: throw-ender_pearl-flat
about: Траектория брошенного ender_pearl: взгляд 0°, на месте. Сверка по тактам: появление, скорость, сдвиги.

random.name: north-facing launch yaw from random X sign
random.why: vanilla-throw-snowball-flat.json has vx=+0.001343 and yaw=127; vanilla-throw-snowball-walk/ender_pearl-flat have vx<0 and yaw=-128. atan2 uses noisy launch direction before inherited motion; these adjacent byte values are random, not a fixed wrap correction. No movement, timing or position tolerance.

random.name: flat launch pitch from random Y sign
random.why: vanilla-throw-ender_pearl-flat.json has vy=+0.000977 and pitch=0; ours vy=-0.016603 and pitch=-1. Both are within observed launch spread; floor quantization preserves the sign. Only the two adjacent angle bytes are masked.
